name: document intake into the brief ledger
purpose: marker parser, scan wiring, `--findings` to open-question statements for `brief add --from`.
responsibilities: src/define/ledgers.js parseBriefFromFile parses a leading `[kind]` marker and a trailing `(source: ...)` marker on each non-empty line; a line without `[kind]` takes `--kind` (default `capability`); a line without `(source: ...)` takes `--source` or the file path; `?`-, `TBC`-, `TBD`-, `Open:`- and `Question:`-leading lines kind `openQuestion` unless a marker says otherwise; an unknown `[kind]` raises LedgerError code 'usage' before any write; a 0.29.0 line-per-statement file parses unchanged.

src/cli/ledger.js `brief add` wires `--scan` / `--no-scan` (default on with `--from`, off with `--text`); runs the mechanical scans in src/intake/orchestrator.js over new statements against existing ones; `--findings <path>` accepts the shape `rcf discover intake --input` takes and makes one `openQuestion` statement per finding with `source: scan:<name>:<ids>`; `--dry-run` prints added + findings and writes nothing; `--json` emits `{ added: [...], findings: [...] }`; `--no-scan` together with `--findings` exits 2.
On a frozen tree the comparison set is every existing statement. Two statement files added in sequence scan the second against the first and the finding's `scan:` source names ids from both.
internalStructure: parseBriefFromFile returns drafts { text, kind, source } one per non-empty line. The CLI mints statements through addEntry; when scans are on it calls runIntakeScansOnDelta(newStatements, existingStatements) over the just-minted ids and the pre-existing body, then appends one openQuestion per finding whose source names the scan and the involved ids. `--findings` reads a JSON object with a `validationFindings[]` array (the same shape `rcf discover intake --input` accepts) and converts each entry to an openQuestion statement whose text is `detail` and whose source is `scan:<kind>`. `--dry-run` composes the full plan with every finding already converted and writes nothing.

interfaces.name: parseStatementFile
interfaces.description: [draft] Parse a statement file into drafts { text, kind, source } one per non-empty line, honouring the leading [kind] and trailing (source: ...) markers and the kind defaults the caller supplies.

interfaces.name: runIntakeScansOnDelta
interfaces.description: [draft] Run the mechanical intake scans over the newly minted statements against every existing statement and return a flat findings array.

interfaces.name: rcf define ledger brief add --from --scan --no-scan --findings --dry-run --json
interfaces.description: Add brief statements from a statement file, optionally running the intake scans and converting operator-supplied findings into openQuestion statements.

notes: This TAC covers the writer-side intake wiring only. The question-computation surface and the Register-prompt replacement land in PR 2 and are not covered here.
